children.label: Custom Date
children.help_text:
To use custom date format. and for more ( https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/cms/hubl/filters#datetimeformat-deprecated- )

Example:-
Date - %d  ||
 Weekdays - %A (Monday, Tuesday)  || Months - %B (January, February)/ %b   (Jan, Feb)/ %m (1, 2)  || 
Year - %Y
